title: Temporal kurtosis of area-weighted optical pulses: no established incremental respiratory-rate accuracy in two cohorts
abstract: Area-weighted temporal-kurtosis modulation did not establish incremental respiratory-rate accuracy beyond five PPG modulation spectra: equal-record MAE gain was -0.0920 breaths/min (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.3274 to 0.1267) in BIDMC and 0.2063 (-0.1292 to 0.6137) in independently collected CapnoBase. Both intervals include zero; this is inconclusive, not equivalence or absence of physiological information. Unfitted algorithms compared on53 ICU and42 perioperative records. Both datasets previously exposed: exploratory external transport, not untouched confirmation. No clinical utility established.
